development: 2018-2024 expanding-year folds; tuning uses expanding 2019-2024 folds only
validation: 2025; first 70% of distinct dates fit calibration, last 30% choose none/Platt/isotonic; final chosen calibrator refit on all 2025
holdout: Sealed official 2026 snapshot; single final run; online history may update after recorded result availability; no refitting or tuning
secondary: LCKC/CK, LDL, PCS/LCP/LMS, VCS, CBLOL/LTA S, LJL: ratings only
selection: minimum pooled development fold log loss; no base-model selection on 2025
baseline: v6 code unchanged, fixed v6 selected model/settings; re-fit on primary 2018-2024; same reporting games; tuned Elo also development-selected
series_policy: OE game ordinal and available prior same-day team-pair results; scheduled best-of absent unless explicit pre-game schedule supplied; no inference from final series length
freeze: Hash source, manifests, input DB, fitted models, calibration, protocol and feature lists before opening holdout. Exclusive single-run claim; no rerun or code changes afterward.
